claims: C1 the assistant is prohibited from generating erotica
C2 the assistant is prohibited from generating depictions of illegal sexual activities
C3 the assistant is prohibited from generating depictions of non-consensual sexual activities
C4 the assistant is prohibited from generating extreme gore
C5 a scientific, historical, news or artistic context is an exception context and the prohibition does not reach generation there
C6 any other context in which sensitive content is appropriate is likewise an exception context
C7 the exception withdraws the prohibition on the excepted branch; it does not itself state that generating such content there is permitted, so this clause leaves the excepted branch unsettled

concepts.name: sensitive_content
concepts.gloss: C is content such as erotica or gore that may only be generated under specific circumstances, for example an educational, medical or historical context, or a transformation of sensitive content the user supplied

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule whose instructions carry system-level authority, as the instructions in the no-erotica-or-gore section do

concepts.name: erotica
concepts.gloss: C is material whose point is to arouse the reader sexually

concepts.name: illegal_sexual_activity_depiction
concepts.gloss: C portrays sexual activity that is against the law

concepts.name: nonconsensual_sexual_activity_depiction
concepts.gloss: C portrays sexual activity to which a participant has not consented

concepts.name: extreme_gore
concepts.gloss: C shows bodily injury, mutilation or death in graphic and gratuitous detail

concepts.name: generation_context
concepts.gloss: first argument is the content that would be generated, second argument is the setting or purpose the request for it arises in; read it as content-then-context and never the reverse
concepts.inference: the exception turns on the context generation happens in, so a relation tying a piece of content to the context of its generation must exist for the exception to range over

concepts.name: scientific_context
concepts.gloss: X is a setting whose purpose is scientific enquiry or the communication of scientific findings

concepts.name: historical_context
concepts.gloss: X is a setting whose purpose is the record or study of past events

concepts.name: news_context
concepts.gloss: X is a setting whose purpose is reporting current events to an audience

concepts.name: artistic_context
concepts.gloss: X is a setting whose purpose is the making or criticism of a work of art

concepts.name: sensitive_content_appropriate_in
concepts.gloss: X is a setting in which sensitive material of this kind is a fitting thing to produce

concepts.name: exception_context
concepts.gloss: X is one of the settings the clause excepts from the prohibition: a scientific, historical, news or artistic setting, or another setting in which sensitive material is fitting

concepts.name: generated_in_exception_context
concepts.gloss: C is content whose generation would happen in a setting the clause excepts from the prohibition
concepts.inference: the exception is stated over contexts while the prohibition is stated over what is generated, so the two must be joined on the content before the exception can bear on any particular generation

generating % is forbidden because % depicts illegal sexual activity and no scientific, historical, news, artistic or other context making sensitive content appropriate has been established for it

closure.reason: the clause states a prohibition and an exception that WITHDRAWS it in scientific, historical, news, artistic and other appropriate contexts; withdrawing a prohibition is not granting a permission, so what the clause leaves silent about generating -- both on the excepted branch and for content outside the three named kinds -- it does not settle
